description: The export of an L8 material channel (decision 169, release gap l8-material-channel-png: Painter's PNG 16 of Dota 2's empty L8 Specular holds (14330, 2570, 14330)), under Legacy on the authored 2x2 plane grid at 256 px: BaseColor edited to L8, Specular and Emissive added as L8. One fill per set with the three channels, Normal at opacity 1: grey A (16-bit) on s0, the authored 8-bit grey ramp (column x holds code x) on s1, a uniform 0.37 on s2; s3 the empty stack (the base). The three maps as RGB and as L at PNG 8, PNG 16 and OpenEXR 32f (the linear control), infinite padding, no dithering, every export step done twice in the session.
